title: .filex-apps.json
description: The file a repository carries at its root, next to filex-app.json, to be listed in the filex Apps store. Read at the submitted tag's commit: it is the repository owner's consent to the listing under the named publisher, and the listing's own metadata, reviewed together with the code.

publisher.description: The store publisher id this repository is listed under. Must be the publisher the submitter acts for, and that publisher must be bound to this repository's GitHub owner.

categories.description: Store category ids (GET /api/v1/categories). Language packs need none.

summary.description: One sentence for the catalog card, per language. English is required when present.

description.description: Path of a Markdown file in the repository shown on the app's page (rendered through a sanitizer; no HTML that runs). Defaults to none.

icon.description: Path of a square PNG or WebP icon in the repository, 128 to 1024 px. Without one the store draws the manifest's icon name.

screenshots.description: Up to 8 screenshots (PNG, JPEG or WebP), shown in this order. The store mirrors them by sha256; it never links to GitHub.

conversions.description: Which kinds of file the app converts into which, reviewed with the code and searched by the store's file-type search (a search for .docx finds an app whose `from` names docx). Each entry says: a file of every `from` extension converts into every `to` extension, needing every engine of `needs` on the filex it runs in; without `needs` it needs nothing else. A pair that works with any one of several engines is written once per engine. Every engine in `needs` must be one the manifest asks for (an `engines:<id>` permission; `office` is the ONLYOFFICE Document Server connected to filex). Declare what the app really offers, never more: a reviewer compares it with the code. At most 16384 from-to pairs in all.

from.description: Extensions converted from; none of them in `to`.

to.description: Extensions converted into (the output file's extension).

needs.description: Engines the conversion needs, all of them; absent: none.
